meta.name: understand-onboard
meta.description: Use when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成新成员快速上手的入门指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要帮新成员快速上手项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate a quick-start guide for new team members
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're welcoming new teammates and want them up to speed fast.

howto.what: Claude会检查项目里有没有/understand生成的分析文件;没有就叫你先运行/understand。有就读取它,生成一份给新人的入职指南,包含项目概览、架构分层、核心概念、学习路线、文件说明和难点提示,还能问你要不要存成文件。
howto.when: 当你说要为新加入项目的成员生成入职指南时触发。但项目得先有/understand生成的分析文件;否则Claude会让你先运行/understand。

say.text: 为新成员生成一份项目入职指南
say.note: Claude会检查分析文件并写出指南。
Claude会询问是否保存该文件。

say.text: 为新成员写一份指南,把高复杂度文件单列出来
say.note: 指南里会包含复杂度热点部分。

howto.what_en: If the project knowledge graph is missing, Claude asks to run /understand. Otherwise it reads the graph and writes a Markdown onboarding guide with overview, layers, key concepts, tour, file map, and hotspots, then offers to save it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project. The project must have been analyzed by /understand; otherwise Claude tells the user to run /understand.

say_en.text: Generate an onboarding guide for new members.
say_en.note: Claude checks the knowledge graph and drafts the guide.

say_en.text: After generating, save it as docs/ONBOARDING.md.
say_en.note: Claude asks whether to save the file.

say_en.text: Write a guide for new members and list high-complexity files separately.
say_en.note: The guide includes a complexity hotspots section.
